name: little-log
description: Newborn tracker – web app, packaged for iOS and Android with Capacitor

scripts.sync: npm run build:web && cap sync && node scripts/native-config.js
scripts.android: npm run sync && cap open android
scripts.ios: npm run sync && cap open ios
scripts.apk: npm run sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.aab: npm run sync && cd android && ./gradlew bundleRelease
